The hosted receipt-notary publish endpoint rejected the purpose-scoped token as unauthorized; the signed receipt and valid local-development verification verdict are therefore published in the public PR without claiming hosted notarization.

decision_observations.reason: Acme Corp is listed in procurement_policy.approved_vendors; USD 75 is at or below max_single_purchase USD 500, at or below requires_approval_above USD 200, at or below current_budget_balance USD 1000, and at or below the requested budget-bounded scope max_amount USD 100, so the purchase is approved in full.

refusal_observations.refused_reason: Refused: USD 1500 exceeds current_budget_balance USD 400 by USD 1100 (budget overage), exceeds procurement_policy.max_single_purchase USD 500 by USD 1000, and vendor Shady Parts Co is not in procurement_policy.approved_vendors [Acme Corp, TechHub] (policy violation). No approved vendor, cap, or threshold is invented to cover the gap.
refusal_observations.cited_policy_violation: vendor Shady Parts Co absent from procurement_policy.approved_vendors; amount above procurement_policy.max_single_purchase USD 500

escalation.reason: Out-of-policy spend and a budget overage require a human approval lane; the run blocks here rather than guessing. No ceiling is emitted, so the downstream C3 spend/refund runner has nothing to consume and the spend cannot fire.

handoff_seam.description: The bounded ceiling is the seam. A downstream driver hands the emitted runx.attenuation_request.v1 to the core spend/refund accepting runner (C3), which alone mints, reserves, settles, and seals the attenuated subset capped at that ceiling. This skill emits the ceiling itself, never an attenuated subset, and never mints, reserves, settles, or moves money.
handoff_seam.denial_consequence: A denial or a blocked approval emits no ceiling, so C3 has nothing to consume and the spend cannot fire.
handoff_seam.human_lane: Out-of-policy spend, a currency mismatch, or unclear budget authority routes to a human approval lane that blocks rather than guesses.
